result.title: AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
result.comment: 8-page main paper with references and supplementary material (15 pages); 5 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI Project page: https://starsholic.github.io/AeroRSI/
result.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to follow natural-language instructions, yet still fail frequently in closed-loop flight. Correcting these failures requires repairs, i.e., actions that avoid them at the states the policy itself reaches, which human pilots cannot label at scale and rule-based planners cannot supply reliably. In this paper, we present AeroRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework in which an aerial navigation policy iteratively learns from its own failures. Our key insight is that a failing policy should judge its own repairs by flying on from them. Judged in this way, its sampled actions and even rule-based proposals that hurt it when imitated directly become reliable supervision. Moreover, an episode terminates at its first failure, concealing subsequent failures until the earlier ones are repaired. AeroRSI thus renews its supervision in every round, anchoring the failures of the current policy, verifying repairs by its continuation, and distilling them while keeping its behavior elsewhere. On TravelUAV, three rounds raise the success rate of a supervised 2B-parameter policy from 46.4% to 67.5% and reduce collisions by half, surpassing the previous state of the art by 10.6 points from the same initialization without extra human labels or inference cost. Code and models are available at https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AeroRSI，一个面向无人机视觉-语言-动作导航的递归自我改进框架：每轮在策略自身到达的失败状态上收集修复动作，以「从该动作继续飞行的结果」判定修复是否有效，再蒸馏为监督并保留原有行为，在 TravelUAV 上三轮将 2B 模型成功率从 46.4% 提到 67.5%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以续跑结果验证修复」可视为对中间状态的反事实式贡献分配，与 LVR 中轨迹训练、步骤监督归属和 rollout 验证 latent 状态有用性存在方法线索可供核查，但应用场景为空中导航控制，未涉及内部 latent 表示本身。
